patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Slack and Cisco Webex share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Slack only if your buying job matches “Channel-based team messaging platform — Free $0, Pro $7.25/user/month annual, Business+ $1” rather than Cisco Webex's shape. Choose Cisco Webex only if your buying job matches “Enterprise UC suite (meetings, messaging, Webex Calling) — Meet/Suite published floors; Ca” rather than Slack's shape. Workflow advantage: Slack leans shared coverage; Cisco Webex leans business-phone, contact-center. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Slack and Cisco Webex share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Slack is Channel-based team messaging platform — Free $0, Pro $7.25/user/month annual, Business+ $15, Enterprise+ contact sales; huddles for light vi; Cisco Webex is Enterprise UC suite (meetings, messaging, Webex Calling) — Meet/Suite published floors; Calling and Contact Center often quote-layered..
- Company-size focus: Slack (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Cisco Webex (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Slack-leaning — vs Cisco Webex-leaning business-phone, contact-center.
- Researched limits: Slack — Not a business phone system — no cloud phone, call routing, recording or power dialer; Cisco Webex — Paid Meet/Suite seat dollars are medium confidence — pricing UI is region/SKU dynamic.

Limitations — Slack: Not a business phone system — no cloud phone, call routing, recording or power dialer; No SMS or WhatsApp Business customer channels; Cisco Webex: Paid Meet/Suite seat dollars are medium confidence — pricing UI is region/SKU dynamic; Full Calling + Contact Center depth is often EA/quote layered beyond Suite list floors.

Poor-fit cases: Slack is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a business phone system — no cloud phone, call routing, recording or power dialer · Cisco Webex is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Paid Meet/Suite seat dollars are medium confidence — pricing UI is region/SKU dynamic · Avoid Slack if you actually need Cisco Webex's motion (Enterprise UC suite (meetings, messaging, Webex Calling) — Meet/Suite published )

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
